title: Cooperative Switched Formation Control of Autonomous Vehicles: An Event-triggered Approach to Input Saturation and Time-delay Challenges
summary: This paper presents a collaborative adaptive formation control framework for autonomous vehicles (AVs), that explicitly handles system uncertainties, input saturation, and communication delays. To overcome the inherent physical torque limits of steering and braking actuators, an input saturation compensation mechanism is introduced to render nonlinearities tractable and improve control reliability.
